teaser: The ABP in the SGit × Ruflo run is compiled into Ruflo's rules and guards the adapter's tools; Ruflo's own command line reaches the memory without it.
core_idea: Every step the ABP guarded behaved as written, but the policy is enforced by the adapter on its three tools, while Ruflo's command line writes and reads the same memory file directly in steps 3, 9 and 10; a policy holds only on the paths through its enforcer, and compiling the rows into Ruflo's own policy engine is one way to cover the rest.
